title: Balance Spread Over a Plan While a Waiver Request Awaits the Committee — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
On a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, the balance a direct-payment repayment plan spreads over its months depends on a waiver request awaiting the Committee on Waivers and Compromises.

## Rule

- **Report attached.** When a waiver request with a Financial Status Report attached was received on the debt within the last calendar month counted back from today and the debt notice is no more than the debt type's waiver window in calendar days old, the balance to be spread is the outstanding balance less the amount that waiver request asks VA to waive (the amount asked on the latest waiver request on the debt).
- **No report.** When only a waiver request without a report was received in that month and the notice is within that window, the amount asked is not relied on because the request is incomplete; the balance to be spread is instead the outstanding balance scaled down by the plain-request reduction of 20 percent of that balance, rounded to the cent.
- **Otherwise** this rule does not change the balance to be spread.

**The last calendar month.** A request falls in it when less than one whole calendar month has passed from its date of receipt to today: on 20 October, a request received on 21 September counts, one received on 20 September does not. **The notice age** is counted in calendar days from the notice date to today; a notice exactly as old as the window is within it.

| Debt type | Waiver window (calendar days after the notice) |
|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 180 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 180 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 180 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 365 |

## Hypothetical cases

| Waiver request in the last month | Notice age, debt type | Outstanding balance | Balance to be spread |
|---|---|---|---|
| With a report, asking 1,200.00 USD | 90 days, Veterans Pension Overpayment | 3,000.00 USD | 1,800.00 USD |
| Without a report | 90 days, Veterans Pension Overpayment | 3,000.00 USD | 3,000.00 less 20 percent of it, that is 2,400.00 USD |
| With a report | 200 days, Veterans Pension Overpayment | 3,000.00 USD | Not changed by this rule |
| With a report | 200 days, Home Loan Guaranty Debt, asking 1,000.00 USD | 3,000.00 USD | 2,000.00 USD |
